tldr: 台股9月30日收漲308點至47,940點，9月單月大漲1,811點。
AI需求催動2026半導體上行，台積電估營收成長逾30%，面板三虎受CPO與記憶體利多鎖漲停。
金管會8大新制9月30日上路、壽險因應IFRS 17/ICS，銀行擴大高資產與海外ETF財富平台。

items.title_zh: 台股9月30日收漲308點 單月大漲1,811點
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks close up 308 points as September caps a strong month
items.summary_zh: 加權指數9月30日終場上漲308.17點、漲幅0.65%，收在47,940.13點，成交量8,756.73億元；盤中一度衝上48,300點之上，尾盤因台積電回檔收斂漲幅。9月單月累計上漲1,811點，延續2026年多頭格局，顯示資金持續回補、多方氣勢未歇。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's TAIEX rose 308.17 points (+0.65%) on Sept 30 to close at 47,940.13, with turnover of NT$875.7 billion. The index briefly topped 48,300 intraday before paring gains as TSMC's late-session dip trimmed the advance. For September the benchmark added 1,811 points, extending its 2026 uptrend as buyers kept rotating back in.

items.title_zh: 資金換軌 三大族群成吸金王
items.title_en: Money rotates into new leaders as heavyweights hold firm
items.summary_zh: 9月30日盤面出現明顯資金遷徙，領軍族群由傳統金融股轉向三大新主流；權值股同步走穩，台積電漲5元收2,480元、聯發科漲10元收4,920元、台達電漲55元收1,890元。外資受匯率波動影響仍偏保守，成交量尚未顯著放大，市場處於半信半疑階段。
items.summary_en: Sept 30 trading showed a clear rotation of funds, with three groups emerging as the day's biggest magnets for capital rather than the usual financial names. TSMC firmed NT$5 to NT$2,480, MediaTek gained NT$10 to NT$4,920 and Delta rose NT$55 to NT$1,890, while foreign investors stayed cautious amid FX swings and turnover that has yet to expand sharply.

items.title_zh: AI需求領軍 台積電催動2026半導體上行循環
items.title_en: AI demand to drive TSMC and the 2026 chip upcycle
items.summary_zh: 法人預期2026年半導體景氣由AI與台積電主導，受惠AI伺服器與先進封裝需求，全球晶片營收成長上看逾兩成。台積電預估2026全年營收成長逾30%，3奈米、特殊製程與先進封裝（CoWoS）全面吃緊，首季淨利估年增約50%，AI、雲端、HBM構成產業四大主軸。
items.summary_en: Analysts expect AI and TSMC to lead the 2026 semiconductor cycle, with global chip revenue growth forecast in the mid-20s percent on AI-server and advanced-packaging demand. TSMC guides for full-year 2026 revenue growth above 30%, with 3nm, specialty processes and advanced packaging (CoWoS) fully booked; first-quarter net profit is seen up about 50% year-on-year.

items.title_zh: 面板三虎兩大利多鎖漲停
items.title_en: Panel trio hits limit-up on twin catalysts
items.summary_zh: 9月30日面板族群領漲台股，面板三虎受惠AI光通訊（CPO）題材與記憶體報價回升兩大利多鎖上漲停；友達、群創爆量走強帶動光電族群攻堅。市場高度期待AI顯示應用落地，帶動下游面板廠展開備貨潮，產業景氣回溫訊號轉強。
items.summary_en: Display makers led Taiwan's Sept 30 gains, with the "big three" panel names locking limit-up on two positive catalysts tied to AI optical communication (CPO) and firmer memory pricing. AUO and Innolux drew heavy volume as the optoelectronics group rallied, reflecting a restocking wave among downstream panel plants ahead of AI-display applications coming to market.

items.title_zh: 金管會8大新制9月30日上路
items.title_en: Eight new financial rules take effect from Sept 30
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布8項新制與新措施上路，其中6項與證券有關、2項為保險會計新制。上市櫃公司股東會議事手冊及年報須提前上傳（會前30天及14天），公開發行公司財報改採電子化無紙申報，集保並建置電子化紀念品平台供股東電子投票後線上領券，強化資訊揭露與便民。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's FSC rolled out eight new measures, six covering securities and two covering insurance accounting. Listed firms must upload shareholder-meeting handbooks and annual reports earlier — 30 and 14 days before meetings — financial-report filings move fully paperless, and an e-gift platform lets shareholders claim vouchers after e-voting, tightening disclosure and cutting paperwork.

items.title_zh: 金管會三面向強化壽險體質 引導資金投入國內公建
items.title_en: FSC pushes insurers to strengthen balance sheets, channel funds to public works
items.summary_zh: 隨IFRS 17與ICS新制2026年上路，金管會提出三面向強化壽險業財務體質，預期高利率「長期保證」保單將逐步退場；同時引導保險業龐大資金投入國內公共建設，兼顧清償能力與資金運用效率，推動保險資本支持實體經濟。
items.summary_en: Regulators outlined a three-pronged effort to improve life insurers' financial quality as IFRS 17 and the ICS solvency regime take effect in 2026, expecting high-rate long-term guaranteed policies to gradually fade. The FSC is also steering insurers' large capital pools toward domestic public-infrastructure investment while balancing solvency.

items.title_zh: 銀行雙軸布局 搶攻高資產與海外ETF平台
items.title_en: Banks build dual-track wealth platforms for HNW clients and offshore ETFs
items.summary_zh: 台灣銀行業以高資產客群與海外投資為主軸擴張財富管理。高雄銀行以「國外股票及ETF投資平台」與「高資產業務」雙軸全面升級，平台於2026年初上線、高資產業務同步開辦，結合南台灣產業聚落與在地資源，導入專業顧問與客製化服務，提升資產配置效率與財富管理深度。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese banks are expanding wealth management around high-net-worth (HNW) clients and offshore investing. Bank of Kaohsiung is upgrading its franchise on two axes — an overseas equity and ETF platform launched in early 2026 and a new HNW wealth-management business — linking southern Taiwan's industrial clusters with tailored advisory to deepen asset allocation.

items.title_zh: 逾七成高資產客戶已布局境外資產
items.title_en: Over 70% of Taiwan's wealthy now hold offshore assets
items.summary_zh: 財富報告指出，台灣高資產客群至2027年上看14萬人、資產規模達46兆元，近全台財富兩成。在全球政經不確定性升高下，逾七成高資產客戶已布局境外資產配置，核心目標聚焦財富保值、稅務規劃與資產增長，投資放眼全球而非侷限台灣，反映風險規避與傳承需求升溫。
items.summary_en: Wealth reports show Taiwan's HNW population heading toward 140,000 people and NT$46 trillion in assets by 2027, near a fifth of national wealth. Amid rising geopolitical and macro uncertainty, more than 70% of HNW clients have allocated to offshore assets, prioritizing wealth preservation, tax planning and global diversification over Taiwan-only exposure.
